They also mention a desire to contribute through collaborative work, clear reasoning, and learning from peers.

The applicant lists several activities including being a varsity soccer player, member of the school art club, environmental club volunteer, youth orchestra musician, science club member, community food bank volunteer, library volunteer, and animal shelter volunteer.
The applicant reports receiving an MVP award.
The applicant is noted as an international student on visa.
